entries.claim: Historical English Agnus mercy invocation underlying this received formula. The printed who takest is recast as You take; punctuation is modernized. The selected contemporary sentence is a revision, not a verbatim historical quotation.

Historical English Agnus peace invocation underlying this received formula. The printed who takest is recast as You take and give us peace as grant us peace; punctuation is modernized. The selected contemporary sentence is a revision, not a verbatim historical quotation.
